segments.tr: المنفعة الجوهرية هي ما تعد به حقاً.

segments.src: The augmented layer is where a lot of modern competition happens — free two-day shipping and a no-questions return policy are product decisions, not just logistics ones.
segments.tr: الطبقة المعززة هي حيث تحدث الكثير من المنافسة الحديثة — الشحن المجاني لمدة يومين وسياسة الإرجاع دون طرح أسئلة هي قرارات متعلقة بالمنتج، وليست مجرد قرارات لوجستية.

segments.src: Four levers sit on top of that framework.
segments.tr: توجد أربع رافعات فوق هذا الإطار.

segments.src: The product life cycle (PLC).** Most products move through four stages, and the right marketing move changes in each one:
segments.tr: دورة حياة المنتج (PLC).** تمر معظم المنتجات بأربع مراحل، وتتغير الخطوة التسويقية الصحيحة في كل منها:

segments.src: Introduction -> Growth -> Maturity -> Decline
segments.tr: Introduction -> Growth -> Maturity -> Decline

segments.src: - *Introduction:* low sales, high cost per customer, heavy spending to build awareness. Profits are often negative.
segments.tr: - *التقديم:* مبيعات منخفضة، تكلفة عالية لكل عميل، إنفاق كثيف لبناء الوعي. غالباً ما تكون الأرباح سلبية.

segments.src: - *Growth:* sales accelerate, competitors arrive, you add features and channels.
segments.tr: - *النمو:* تتسارع المبيعات، ويصل المنافسون، وتضيف ميزات وقنوات جديدة.

segments.src: - *Maturity:* sales plateau, the fight turns to share and price, marketing shifts to differentiation and defending shelf space. Most products you know live here.
segments.tr: - *النضج:* تستقر المبيعات، ويتحول الصراع إلى الحصة السوقية والسعر، ويتحول التسويق إلى التمايز والدفاع عن مساحة الرفوف. معظم المنتجات التي تعرفها تعيش هنا.

segments.src: - *Decline:* sales fall; you harvest (cut costs, milk cash flow) or divest.
segments.tr: - *الانحدار:* تنخفض المبيعات؛ تقوم بالحصد (خفض التكاليف، استغلال التدفق النقدي) أو التصفية.

segments.src: Two honest caveats: the PLC is a description, not a law.
segments.tr: تحذيران صادقان: دورة حياة المنتج هي وصف وليست قانوناً.

segments.src: Some products die in introduction; others (Coca-Cola, Tabasco, Levi's 501s) sit in maturity for a century.
segments.tr: بعض المنتجات تموت في مرحلة التقديم؛ بينما تظل أخرى (مثل Coca-Cola، وTabasco، وLevi's 501s) في مرحلة النضج لقرن من الزمان.

segments.src: And "decline" is sometimes a marketing failure, not a market verdict.
segments.tr: و"الانحدار" يكون أحياناً فشلاً تسويقياً، وليس حكماً من السوق.

segments.src: Brand.** A brand is a name, term, sign, or design that identifies a seller's product and separates it from competitors.
segments.tr: العلامة التجارية.** العلامة التجارية هي اسم أو مصطلح أو علامة أو تصميم يحدد منتج البائع ويفصله عن المنافسين.

segments.src: Its economic value — **brand equity** — is the extra response you get *because* of the name.
segments.tr: قيمتها الاقتصادية — **قيمة العلامة التجارية (brand equity)** — هي الاستجابة الإضافية التي تحصل عليها *بسبب* الاسم.

segments.src: Same laptop, two badges, different price people will pay: that gap is equity.
segments.tr: نفس الكمبيوتر المحمول، بشعارين مختلفين، وسعران مختلفان يدفعهما الناس: تلك الفجوة هي القيمة.

segments.src: Equity comes from awareness (do they know you?), perceived quality, associations (what comes to mind?), and loyalty (will they walk past a cheaper option?).
segments.tr: تأتي القيمة من الوعي (هل يعرفونك؟)، والجودة المدركة، والارتباطات (ما الذي يتبادر إلى الذهن؟)، والولاء (هل سيتجاهلون خياراً أرخص؟).

segments.src: Companies choose a **brand architecture**: a *house of brands* (P&G sells Tide, Charmin, Gillette — most shoppers don't connect them) or a *branded house* (Google Maps, Google Drive, Google Pay all borrow one reputation).
segments.tr: تختار الشركات **هيكلية العلامة التجارية**: *بيت العلامات التجارية* (P&G تبيع Tide وCharmin وGillette — معظم المتسوقين لا يربطون بينها) أو *البيت ذو العلامة التجارية الواحدة* (Google Maps وGoogle Drive وGoogle Pay تستعير جميعها سمعة واحدة).

segments.src: House of brands contains damage; branded house spreads goodwill cheaply.
segments.tr: بيت العلامات التجارية يحتوي الضرر؛ بينما البيت ذو العلامة التجارية الواحدة ينشر السمعة الطيبة بتكلفة زهيدة.

segments.src: Neither is free.
segments.tr: لا شيء منهما مجاني.

segments.src: Packaging.** Packaging protects the product, communicates it, and increasingly *is* the experience — think of the box an iPhone comes in.
segments.tr: التغليف.** يحمي التغليف المنتج، ويوصل رسالته، وبشكل متزايد *يصبح* هو التجربة نفسها — فكر في الصندوق الذي يأتي فيه هاتف iPhone.

segments.src: On a crowded shelf, the package is often the only ad running at the moment of decision.
segments.tr: على رف مزدحم، غالباً ما يكون الغلاف هو الإعلان الوحيد الذي يعمل في لحظة اتخاذ القرار.

segments.src: It also carries legal weight in the US: FDA-required Nutrition Facts, FTC rules against deceptive claims, and the growing scrutiny of "sustainable" labeling.
segments.tr: كما أنه يحمل ثقلاً قانونياً في الولايات المتحدة: حقائق التغذية المطلوبة من قبل إدارة الغذاء والدواء (FDA)، وقواعد لجنة التجارة الفيدرالية (FTC) ضد الادعاءات المضللة، والتدقيق المتزايد في الملصقات "المستدامة".

segments.src: New product development (NPD).** The standard funnel:
segments.tr: تطوير منتج جديد (NPD).** القمع القياسي:

segments.src: Idea generation -> Screening -> Concept test -> Business analysis
segments.tr: Idea generation -> Screening -> Concept test -> Business analysis

segments.src: -> Product development -> Test market -> Commercialization
segments.tr: -> Product development -> Test market -> Commercialization

segments.src: Each gate is designed to kill bad ideas cheaply.
segments.tr: تم تصميم كل بوابة للتخلص من الأفكار السيئة بتكلفة منخفضة.

segments.src: That's the point — failing at concept test costs a survey; failing at commercialization costs a factory run.
segments.tr: هذا هو الهدف — الفشل في اختبار المفهوم يكلف استطلاع رأي؛ الفشل في التسويق يكلف تشغيل مصنع.

segments.src: New consumer packaged goods fail at high rates (industry estimates commonly land somewhere in the 70–80% range, and definitions of "failure" vary a lot), which is exactly why the gates exist.
segments.tr: تفشل السلع الاستهلاكية المعبأة الجديدة بمعدلات عالية (تقديرات الصناعة عادة ما تقع في نطاق 70-80%، وتختلف تعريفات "الفشل" كثيراً)، وهذا هو بالضبط سبب وجود البوابات.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## في الحياة اليومية

segments.src: Walk down the beverage aisle at a Target in Ohio and watch all four levers at once.
segments.tr: امشِ في ممر المشروبات في متجر Target في أوهايو وشاهد الرافعات الأربع في وقت واحد.

segments.src: **Coca-Cola Classic** is deep in maturity.
segments.tr: **Coca-Cola Classic** في عمق مرحلة النضج.

segments.src: The formula hasn't meaningfully changed, so the marketing is about occasions, packaging formats, and holding price — a 12-pack at roughly $8–9 is fighting on promotion and placement, not on innovation.
segments.tr: لم تتغير التركيبة بشكل جوهري، لذا فإن التسويق يدور حول المناسبات، وتنسيقات التغليف، والحفاظ على السعر — عبوة من 12 قطعة بسعر 8-9 دولارات تقريباً تحارب من خلال العروض الترويجية ومكان العرض، وليس من خلال الابتكار.

segments.src: The brand equity is doing the heavy lifting: the red disc is recognizable at 20 feet.
segments.tr: قيمة العلامة التجارية تقوم بالعمل الشاق: القرص الأحمر يمكن التعرف عليه من مسافة 20 قدماً.

segments.src: Two shelves over, **Poppi** and **Olipop** are prebiotic sodas in growth stage.
segments.tr: على بعد رفين، **Poppi** و**Olipop** هما مشروبات غازية بريبيوتيك في مرحلة النمو.

segments.src: Higher price (about $2.50–$3 a can), bright packaging built for Instagram, flavors launching and getting pulled fast.
segments.tr: سعر أعلى (حوالي 2.50-3 دولارات للعلبة)، تغليف مشرق مصمم لـ Instagram، نكهات يتم إطلاقها وسحبها بسرعة.

segments.src: That's textbook growth behavior: expand the line, grab distribution, don't worry yet about squeezing margin.
segments.tr: هذا هو سلوك النمو النموذجي: توسيع الخط، الحصول على التوزيع، لا تقلق بعد بشأن ضغط الهامش.

segments.src: Note also what happened next — Olipop and Poppi grew fast enough that PepsiCo acquired Poppi in 2025 for roughly $1.65 billion.
segments.tr: لاحظ أيضاً ما حدث بعد ذلك — نمت Olipop وPoppi بسرعة كافية لدرجة أن PepsiCo استحوذت على Poppi في عام 2025 مقابل حوالي 1.65 مليار دولار.

segments.src: Buying a growth-stage brand is often cheaper than developing one, which is the quiet part of NPD strategy.
segments.tr: شراء علامة تجارية في مرحلة النمو غالباً ما يكون أرخص من تطوير واحدة، وهذا هو الجزء الهادئ من استراتيجية تطوير المنتجات الجديدة (NPD).

segments.src: Now look at the branding architecture.
segments.tr: الآن انظر إلى هيكلية العلامة التجارية.

segments.src: Coke uses a **branded house** for its trademark line — Coke Zero Sugar, Cherry Coke, Coca-Cola Spiced (launched 2024, discontinued within about a year).
segments.tr: تستخدم Coke **البيت ذو العلامة التجارية الواحدة** لخط علامتها التجارية — Coke Zero Sugar، Cherry Coke، Coca-Cola Spiced (تم إطلاقها في 2024، وتم إيقافها في غضون عام تقريباً).

segments.src: That last one is a live PLC lesson: a product can be killed in introduction when trial doesn't convert to repeat.
segments.tr: هذا الأخير هو درس حي في دورة حياة المنتج: يمكن قتل منتج في مرحلة التقديم عندما لا تتحول التجربة إلى تكرار للشراء.

segments.src: But Coca-Cola the *company* runs closer to a house of brands overall — Sprite, Dasani, Smartwater, Topo Chico and Fairlife don't lean on the Coke name at all, so a stumble in one doesn't drag the others.
segments.tr: لكن شركة Coca-Cola كـ *شركة* تعمل بشكل أقرب إلى بيت العلامات التجارية بشكل عام — Sprite، Dasani، Smartwater، Topo Chico وFairlife لا تعتمد على اسم Coke على الإطلاق، لذا فإن التعثر في واحدة لا يسحب الأخريات.

segments.src: And the packaging?
segments.tr: وماذا عن التغليف؟

segments.src: The Poppi can's matte finish and oversized fruit graphic aren't decoration.
segments.tr: اللمسة النهائية غير اللامعة لعلبة Poppi ورسومات الفاكهة كبيرة الحجم ليست مجرد زينة.

segments.src: They signal "not-a-soda soda" to someone scanning for three seconds — the augmented promise of gut health, delivered by aluminum.
segments.tr: إنها تشير إلى "مشروب غازي ليس بمشروب غازي" لشخص يمسح الرفوف في ثلاث ثوانٍ — الوعد المعزز بصحة الأمعاء، الذي يتم تقديمه عبر الألمنيوم.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## ملخص من ثلاثة أسطر

segments.src: 1. A product operates on three levels — core benefit, actual product, augmented product — and competitors copy the middle one fastest.
segments.tr: 1. يعمل المنتج على ثلاثة مستويات — المنفعة الجوهرية، المنتج الفعلي، المنتج المعزز — والمنافسون ينسخون المستوى الأوسط بأسرع ما يمكن.

segments.src: 2. The product life cycle (introduction, growth, maturity, decline) changes which marketing moves make sense, but it describes a pattern rather than dictating a schedule.
segments.tr: 2. تغير دورة حياة المنتج (التقديم، النمو، النضج، الانحدار) التحركات التسويقية التي تكون منطقية، لكنها تصف نمطاً بدلاً من إملاء جدول زمني.

segments.src: 3. Brand equity, packaging, and a gated new-product development process are how firms build value that a feature list alone can't deliver.
segments.tr: 3. قيمة العلامة التجارية، والتغليف، وعملية تطوير المنتجات الجديدة المعتمدة على البوابات هي الطريقة التي تبني بها الشركات قيمة لا يمكن لقائمة الميزات وحدها تقديمها.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ اختبار ذاتي

segments.src: **Q1.** A brand's sales have plateaued, competitors are numerous, and price promotions are the main battleground.
segments.tr: **س1.** استقرت مبيعات علامة تجارية ما، والمنافسون كثيرون، والعروض الترويجية للسعر هي ساحة المعركة الرئيسية.

segments.src: Which PLC stage is this?
segments.tr: أي مرحلة من مراحل دورة حياة المنتج هذه؟

segments.src: - A) Introduction
segments.tr: - أ) التقديم

segments.src: - B) Growth
segments.tr: - ب) النمو

segments.src: - C) Maturity
segments.tr: - ج) النضج

segments.src: - D) Decline
segments.tr: - د) الانحدار

segments.src: **Q2.** Procter & Gamble markets Tide, Charmin, and Gillette without emphasizing the P&G name on the front of the package.
segments.tr: **س2.** تسوق شركة Procter & Gamble منتجات Tide وCharmin وGillette دون التأكيد على اسم P&G على مقدمة العبوة.

segments.src: This is an example of a *branded house*.
segments.tr: هذا مثال على *البيت ذو العلامة التجارية الواحدة*.

segments.src: (O / X)
segments.tr: (صح / خطأ)

segments.src: **Q3.** In the new product development process, which stage comes immediately *before* commercialization?
segments.tr: **س3.** في عملية تطوير منتج جديد، أي مرحلة تأتي مباشرة *قبل* التسويق التجاري؟

segments.src: - A) Concept test
segments.tr: - أ) اختبار المفهوم

segments.src: - B) Idea screening
segments.tr: - ب) فحص الأفكار

segments.src: - C) Test market
segments.tr: - ج) اختبار السوق

segments.src: - D) Business analysis
segments.tr: - د) تحليل الأعمال

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 مصطلحات اليوم

segments.src: - **Core benefit** — the underlying problem the customer is actually paying to solve, beneath any feature.
segments.tr: - **المنفعة الجوهرية** — المشكلة الأساسية التي يدفع العميل المال لحلها فعلياً، تحت أي ميزة.

segments.src: - **Augmented product** — the support layer around the physical good: warranty, service, delivery, returns, community.
segments.tr: - **المنتج المعزز** — طبقة الدعم حول السلعة المادية: الضمان، الخدمة، التوصيل، الإرجاع، المجتمع.

segments.src: - **Product life cycle (PLC)** — the introduction–growth–maturity–decline pattern many products follow, used to match strategy to stage.
segments.tr: - **دورة حياة المنتج (PLC)** — نمط التقديم-النمو-النضج-الانحدار الذي تتبعه العديد من المنتجات، ويستخدم لمطابقة الاستراتيجية مع المرحلة.

segments.src: - **Brand equity** — the added value a brand name contributes to a product, visible as price premium, preference, or loyalty.
segments.tr: - **قيمة العلامة التجارية** — القيمة المضافة التي يساهم بها اسم العلامة التجارية في المنتج، وتظهر كعلاوة سعر، أو تفضيل، أو ولاء.

segments.src: - **House of brands** — a portfolio strategy where individual brands stand alone, so reputation (and risk) doesn't transfer between them.
segments.tr: - **بيت العلامات التجارية** — استراتيجية محفظة حيث تقف العلامات التجارية الفردية بمفردها، بحيث لا تنتقل السمعة (والمخاطر) بينها.

segments.src: - **Test market** — a limited real-world launch used to check demand and marketing mix before full-scale rollout.
segments.tr: - **اختبار السوق** — إطلاق محدود في العالم الحقيقي يستخدم للتحقق من الطلب والمزيج التسويقي قبل الطرح الكامل.

segments.src: *Answers: **Q1 — C.** Flat sales plus intense price competition is the signature of maturity; decline would show sales actually falling.
segments.tr: *الإجابات: **س1 — ج.** استقرار المبيعات بالإضافة إلى المنافسة السعرية الشديدة هي سمة النضج؛ الانحدار سيظهر انخفاضاً فعلياً في المبيعات.

segments.src: **Q2 — X (false).** That's a house of brands: each brand stands alone.
segments.tr: **س2 — خطأ.** هذا بيت علامات تجارية: كل علامة تجارية تقف بمفردها.

segments.src: A branded house is the opposite — one master name across products, like Google Maps and Google Drive.
segments.tr: البيت ذو العلامة التجارية الواحدة هو العكس — اسم رئيسي واحد عبر المنتجات، مثل Google Maps وGoogle Drive.

segments.src: **Q3 — C.** Test market is the last gate before commercialization; it's the final cheap chance to find out you're wrong.*
segments.tr: **س3 — ج.** اختبار السوق هو البوابة الأخيرة قبل التسويق التجاري؛ إنها الفرصة الرخيصة الأخيرة لاكتشاف أنك على خطأ.*

fr.title: [Marketing 101 #7] Pourquoi votre produit préféré est en réalité trois produits dans un trench-coat

segments.src: > A "product" is not just the thing in the box — it's a bundle of benefits with a name, a look, and a lifespan, and marketers manage all four on purpose.
segments.tr: > Un « produit » n'est pas seulement l'objet dans la boîte — c'est un ensemble d'avantages doté d'un nom, d'un design et d'une durée de vie, et les spécialistes du marketing gèrent ces quatre aspects intentionnellement.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Le concept du jour

segments.src: Ask someone what Nike sells and they'll say sneakers.
segments.tr: Demandez à quelqu'un ce que vend Nike et il vous répondra des baskets.

segments.src: But you don't buy a sneaker — you buy cushioning on a long run, a look that works with jeans, and a swoosh that says something about you before you speak.
segments.tr: Mais vous n'achetez pas une basket — vous achetez un amorti pour une course longue, un look qui va avec un jean, et une virgule (swoosh) qui dit quelque chose de vous avant que vous ne parliez.

segments.src: Marketers formalize this with **three levels of product**:
segments.tr: Les marketeurs formalisent cela avec les **trois niveaux de produit** :

segments.src: - **Core benefit** — the problem actually being solved (safe arrival, clean teeth, one less thing to worry about).
segments.tr: - **Avantage fondamental** — le problème réellement résolu (arrivée en toute sécurité, dents propres, un souci en moins).

segments.src: - **Actual product** — the tangible thing: features, quality level, design, brand name, packaging.
segments.tr: - **Produit réel** — l'objet tangible : fonctionnalités, niveau de qualité, design, nom de marque, emballage.

segments.src: - **Augmented product** — everything wrapped around it: warranty, returns, delivery, customer support, the app, the community.
segments.tr: - **Produit augmenté** — tout ce qui l'entoure : garantie, retours, livraison, service client, application, communauté.

segments.src: Competitors usually match you on the actual product fast.
segments.tr: Les concurrents vous égalent généralement rapidement sur le produit réel.

segments.src: The core benefit is what you're really promising.
segments.tr: L'avantage fondamental est ce que vous promettez réellement.

segments.src: The augmented layer is where a lot of modern competition happens — free two-day shipping and a no-questions return policy are product decisions, not just logistics ones.
segments.tr: La couche augmentée est là où se joue une grande partie de la concurrence moderne — la livraison gratuite en deux jours et une politique de retour sans condition sont des décisions de produits, pas seulement de logistique.

segments.src: Four levers sit on top of that framework.
segments.tr: Quatre leviers reposent sur ce cadre.

segments.src: The product life cycle (PLC).** Most products move through four stages, and the right marketing move changes in each one:
segments.tr: Le cycle de vie du produit (CVP).** La plupart des produits traversent quatre étapes, et la bonne décision marketing change pour chacune d'elles :

segments.src: Introduction -> Growth -> Maturity -> Decline
segments.tr: Introduction -> Growth -> Maturity -> Decline

segments.src: - *Introduction:* low sales, high cost per customer, heavy spending to build awareness. Profits are often negative.
segments.tr: - *Introduction :* faibles ventes, coût élevé par client, dépenses importantes pour créer de la notoriété. Les profits sont souvent négatifs.

segments.src: - *Growth:* sales accelerate, competitors arrive, you add features and channels.
segments.tr: - *Croissance :* les ventes s'accélèrent, les concurrents arrivent, vous ajoutez des fonctionnalités et des canaux.

segments.src: - *Maturity:* sales plateau, the fight turns to share and price, marketing shifts to differentiation and defending shelf space. Most products you know live here.
segments.tr: - *Maturité :* les ventes se stabilisent, la lutte se déplace vers la part de marché et le prix, le marketing s'oriente vers la différenciation et la défense de l'espace en rayon. La plupart des produits que vous connaissez vivent ici.

segments.src: - *Decline:* sales fall; you harvest (cut costs, milk cash flow) or divest.
segments.tr: - *Déclin :* les ventes chutent ; vous exploitez (réduction des coûts, maximisation des flux de trésorerie) ou vous désinvestissez.

segments.src: Two honest caveats: the PLC is a description, not a law.
segments.tr: Deux avertissements honnêtes : le CVP est une description, pas une loi.

segments.src: Some products die in introduction; others (Coca-Cola, Tabasco, Levi's 501s) sit in maturity for a century.
segments.tr: Certains produits meurent en phase d'introduction ; d'autres (Coca-Cola, Tabasco, Levi's 501) restent en maturité pendant un siècle.

segments.src: And "decline" is sometimes a marketing failure, not a market verdict.
segments.tr: Et le « déclin » est parfois un échec marketing, pas un verdict du marché.

segments.src: Brand.** A brand is a name, term, sign, or design that identifies a seller's product and separates it from competitors.
segments.tr: La marque.** Une marque est un nom, un terme, un signe ou un design qui identifie le produit d'un vendeur et le distingue de ses concurrents.

segments.src: Its economic value — **brand equity** — is the extra response you get *because* of the name.
segments.tr: Sa valeur économique — le **capital de marque** (brand equity) — est le supplément de réponse que vous obtenez *grâce* au nom.

segments.src: Same laptop, two badges, different price people will pay: that gap is equity.
segments.tr: Même ordinateur portable, deux logos, un prix différent que les gens sont prêts à payer : cet écart est le capital de marque.

segments.src: Equity comes from awareness (do they know you?), perceived quality, associations (what comes to mind?), and loyalty (will they walk past a cheaper option?).
segments.tr: Ce capital provient de la notoriété (vous connaissent-ils ?), de la qualité perçue, des associations (qu'est-ce qui vient à l'esprit ?) et de la fidélité (passeront-ils devant une option moins chère ?).

segments.src: Companies choose a **brand architecture**: a *house of brands* (P&G sells Tide, Charmin, Gillette — most shoppers don't connect them) or a *branded house* (Google Maps, Google Drive, Google Pay all borrow one reputation).
segments.tr: Les entreprises choisissent une **architecture de marque** : une *maison de marques* (P&G vend Tide, Charmin, Gillette — la plupart des acheteurs ne les relient pas) ou une *marque ombrelle / maison de marque* (Google Maps, Google Drive, Google Pay empruntent tous une seule réputation).

segments.src: House of brands contains damage; branded house spreads goodwill cheaply.
segments.tr: La maison de marques contient les dégâts ; la marque ombrelle propage la bonne volonté à moindre coût.

segments.src: Neither is free.
segments.tr: Aucune des deux n'est gratuite.

segments.src: Packaging.** Packaging protects the product, communicates it, and increasingly *is* the experience — think of the box an iPhone comes in.
segments.tr: L'emballage.** L'emballage protège le produit, le communique et, de plus en plus, *est* l'expérience — pensez à la boîte dans laquelle arrive un iPhone.

segments.src: On a crowded shelf, the package is often the only ad running at the moment of decision.
segments.tr: Dans un rayon encombré, l'emballage est souvent la seule publicité diffusée au moment de la décision.

segments.src: It also carries legal weight in the US: FDA-required Nutrition Facts, FTC rules against deceptive claims, and the growing scrutiny of "sustainable" labeling.
segments.tr: Il a également un poids juridique aux États-Unis : les informations nutritionnelles exigées par la FDA, les règles de la FTC contre les allégations trompeuses, et la surveillance croissante de l'étiquetage « durable ».

segments.src: New product development (NPD).** The standard funnel:
segments.tr: Le développement de nouveaux produits (DNP).** L'entonnoir standard :

segments.src: Idea generation -> Screening -> Concept test -> Business analysis
segments.tr: Idea generation -> Screening -> Concept test -> Business analysis

segments.src: -> Product development -> Test market -> Commercialization
segments.tr: -> Product development -> Test market -> Commercialization

segments.src: Each gate is designed to kill bad ideas cheaply.
segments.tr: Chaque étape (gate) est conçue pour éliminer les the mauvaise idées à faible coût.

segments.src: That's the point — failing at concept test costs a survey; failing at commercialization costs a factory run.
segments.tr: C'est le but — échouer lors du test de concept coûte une étude ; échouer lors de la commercialisation coûte une production en usine.

segments.src: New consumer packaged goods fail at high rates (industry estimates commonly land somewhere in the 70–80% range, and definitions of "failure" vary a lot), which is exactly why the gates exist.
segments.tr: Les nouveaux produits de grande consommation échouent à des taux élevés (les estimations de l'industrie se situent généralement entre 70 et 80 %, et les définitions de « l'échec » varient beaucoup), ce qui explique précisément pourquoi ces étapes existent.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Dans la vie de tous les jours

segments.src: Walk down the beverage aisle at a Target in Ohio and watch all four levers at once.
segments.tr: Promenez-vous dans le rayon des boissons d'un Target dans l'Ohio et observez les quatre leviers en même temps.

segments.src: **Coca-Cola Classic** is deep in maturity.
segments.tr: **Coca-Cola Classic** est profondément ancré dans la maturité.

segments.src: The formula hasn't meaningfully changed, so the marketing is about occasions, packaging formats, and holding price — a 12-pack at roughly $8–9 is fighting on promotion and placement, not on innovation.
segments.tr: La formule n'a pas changé de manière significative, le marketing porte donc sur les occasions, les formats d'emballage et le maintien des prix — un pack de 12 à environ 8-9 $ se bat sur la promotion et le placement, pas sur l'innovation.

segments.src: The brand equity is doing the heavy lifting: the red disc is recognizable at 20 feet.
segments.tr: Le capital de marque fait le gros du travail : le disque rouge est reconnaissable à 6 mètres.

segments.src: Two shelves over, **Poppi** and **Olipop** are prebiotic sodas in growth stage.
segments.tr: Deux rayons plus loin, **Poppi** et **Olipop** sont des sodas prébiotiques en phase de croissance.

segments.src: Higher price (about $2.50–$3 a can), bright packaging built for Instagram, flavors launching and getting pulled fast.
segments.tr: Prix plus élevé (environ 2,50 $ à 3 $ la canette), emballage lumineux conçu pour Instagram, saveurs lancées et retirées rapidement.

segments.src: That's textbook growth behavior: expand the line, grab distribution, don't worry yet about squeezing margin.
segments.tr: C'est le comportement de croissance par excellence : élargir la gamme, s'implanter dans la distribution, ne pas s'soucier encore de la compression des marges.

segments.src: Note also what happened next — Olipop and Poppi grew fast enough that PepsiCo acquired Poppi in 2025 for roughly $1.65 billion.
segments.tr: Notez également ce qui s'est passé ensuite — Olipop et Poppi ont poussé assez vite pour que PepsiCo acquière Poppi en 2025 pour environ 1,65 milliard de dollars.

segments.src: Buying a growth-stage brand is often cheaper than developing one, which is the quiet part of NPD strategy.
segments.tr: Acheter une marque en phase de croissance est souvent moins cher que d'en développer une, ce qui est la partie silencieuse de la stratégie de DNP.

segments.src: Now look at the branding architecture.
segments.tr: Regardez maintenant l'architecture de marque.

segments.src: Coke uses a **branded house** for its trademark line — Coke Zero Sugar, Cherry Coke, Coca-Cola Spiced (launched 2024, discontinued within about a year).
segments.tr: Coke utilise une **marque ombrelle** pour sa ligne principale — Coke Zero Sugar, Cherry Coke, Coca-Cola Spiced (lancé en 2024, retiré du marché en environ un an).

segments.src: That last one is a live PLC lesson: a product can be killed in introduction when trial doesn't convert to repeat.
segments.tr: Ce dernier est une leçon vivante du CVP : un produit peut être tué en phase d'introduction lorsque l'essai ne se convertit pas en rachat.

segments.src: But Coca-Cola the *company* runs closer to a house of brands overall — Sprite, Dasani, Smartwater, Topo Chico and Fairlife don't lean on the Coke name at all, so a stumble in one doesn't drag the others.
segments.tr: Mais l'entreprise Coca-Cola ressemble davantage à une maison de marques dans l'ensemble — Sprite, Dasani, Smartwater, Topo Chico et Fairlife ne s'appuient pas du tout sur le nom Coke, de sorte qu'un faux pas chez l'un n'entraîne pas les autres.

segments.src: And the packaging?
segments.tr: Et l'emballage ?

segments.src: The Poppi can's matte finish and oversized fruit graphic aren't decoration.
segments.tr: La finition mate de la canette Poppi et son graphisme de fruit surdimensionné ne sont pas de la décoration.

segments.src: They signal "not-a-soda soda" to someone scanning for three seconds — the augmented promise of gut health, delivered by aluminum.
segments.tr: Ils signalent « un soda qui n'en est pas un » à quelqu'un qui balaie du regard en trois secondes — la promesse augmentée de la santé intestinale, livrée par de l'aluminium.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## Résumé en trois lignes

segments.src: 1. A product operates on three levels — core benefit, actual product, augmented product — and competitors copy the middle one fastest.
segments.tr: 1. Un produit fonctionne sur trois niveaux — avantage fondamental, produit réel, produit augmenté — et les concurrents copient le milieu le plus rapidement.

segments.src: 2. The product life cycle (introduction, growth, maturity, decline) changes which marketing moves make sense, but it describes a pattern rather than dictating a schedule.
segments.tr: 2. Le cycle de vie du produit (introduction, croissance, maturité, déclin) modifie les actions marketing pertinentes, mais il décrit un modèle plutôt qu'il n'impose un calendrier.

segments.src: 3. Brand equity, packaging, and a gated new-product development process are how firms build value that a feature list alone can't deliver.
segments.tr: 3. Le capital de marque, l'emballage et un processus de développement de nouveaux produits jalonné sont la façon dont les entreprises construisent de la valeur qu'une simple liste de fonctionnalités ne peut offrir.

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Termes du jour

segments.src: - **Core benefit** — the underlying problem the customer is actually paying to solve, beneath any feature.
segments.tr: - **Avantage fondamental** — le problème sous-jacent que le client paie réellement pour résoudre, au-delà de toute fonctionnalité.

segments.src: - **Augmented product** — the support layer around the physical good: warranty, service, delivery, returns, community.
segments.tr: - **Produit augmenté** — la couche de support autour du bien physique : garantie, service, livraison, retours, communauté.

segments.src: - **Product life cycle (PLC)** — the introduction–growth–maturity–decline pattern many products follow, used to match strategy to stage.
segments.tr: - **Cycle de vie du produit (CVP)** — le modèle introduction-croissance-maturité-déclin que suivent de nombreux produits, utilisé pour adapter la stratégie à l'étape.

segments.src: - **Brand equity** — the added value a brand name contributes to a product, visible as price premium, preference, or loyalty.
segments.tr: - **Capital de marque (Brand equity)** — la valeur ajoutée qu'un nom de marque apporte à un produit, visible sous forme de surprix, de préférence ou de fidélité.

segments.src: - **House of brands** — a portfolio strategy where individual brands stand alone, so reputation (and risk) doesn't transfer between them.
segments.tr: - **Maison de marques** — une stratégie de portefeuille où les marques individuelles sont autonomes, de sorte que la réputation (et le risque) ne se transmet pas entre elles.

segments.src: - **Test market** — a limited real-world launch used to check demand and marketing mix before full-scale rollout.
segments.tr: - **Marché test** — un lancement réel limité utilisé pour vérifier la demande et le mix marketing avant un déploiement à grande échelle.

segments.tr: *Réponses : **Q1 — C.** Des ventes stables et une concurrence intense sur les prix sont la signature de la maturité ; le déclin montrerait des ventes en chute réelle.

segments.tr: **Q2 — F (faux).** C'est une maison de marques : chaque marque est indépendante.

segments.src: A branded house is the opposite — one master name across products, like Google Maps and Google Drive.
segments.tr: Une marque ombrelle est le contraire — un nom principal à travers les produits, comme Google Maps et Google Drive.

segments.src: **Q3 — C.** Test market is the last gate before commercialization; it's the final cheap chance to find out you're wrong.*
segments.tr: **Q3 — C.** Le marché test est la dernière barrière avant la commercialisation ; c'est la dernière chance bon marché de s'apercevoir que l'on a tort.*

pt.title: [Marketing 101 #7] Por Que Seu Produto Favorito É Realmente Três Produtos em um Trench Coat

segments.src: > A "product" is not just the thing in the box — it's a bundle of benefits with a name, a look, and a lifespan, and marketers manage all four on purpose.
segments.tr: > Um "produto" não é apenas a coisa na caixa — é um conjunto de benefícios com um nome, uma aparência e uma vida útil, e profissionais de marketing gerenciam os quatro propositalmente.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## O Conceito de Hoje

segments.src: Ask someone what Nike sells and they'll say sneakers.
segments.tr: Pergunte a alguém o que a Nike vende e ela dirá tênis.

segments.src: But you don't buy a sneaker — you buy cushioning on a long run, a look that works with jeans, and a swoosh that says something about you before you speak.
segments.tr: Mas você não compra um tênis — você compra amortecimento para uma corrida longa, uma aparência que combina com jeans e um swoosh que diz algo sobre você antes de você falar.

segments.src: Marketers formalize this with **three levels of product**:
segments.tr: Os profissionais de marketing formalizam isso com **três níveis de produto**:

segments.src: - **Core benefit** — the problem actually being solved (safe arrival, clean teeth, one less thing to worry about).
segments.tr: - **Benefício principal** — o problema que está sendo resolvido (chegada segura, dentes limpos, uma coisa a menos para se preocupar).

segments.src: - **Actual product** — the tangible thing: features, quality level, design, brand name, packaging.
segments.tr: - **Produto real** — a coisa tangível: recursos, nível de qualidade, design, nome da marca, embalagem.

segments.src: - **Augmented product** — everything wrapped around it: warranty, returns, delivery, customer support, the app, the community.
segments.tr: - **Produto aumentado** — tudo envolvido: garantia, devoluções, entrega, suporte ao cliente, o aplicativo, a comunidade.

segments.src: Competitors usually match you on the actual product fast.
segments.tr: Os concorrentes geralmente igualam você no produto real rapidamente.

segments.src: The core benefit is what you're really promising.
segments.tr: O benefício principal é o que você está realmente prometendo.

segments.src: The augmented layer is where a lot of modern competition happens — free two-day shipping and a no-questions return policy are product decisions, not just logistics ones.
segments.tr: A camada aumentada é onde muita competição moderna acontece — frete grátis em dois dias e uma política de devolução sem perguntas são decisões de produto, não apenas logísticas.

segments.src: Four levers sit on top of that framework.
segments.tr: Quatro alavancas ficam no topo desse framework.

segments.src: The product life cycle (PLC).** Most products move through four stages, and the right marketing move changes in each one:
segments.tr: O ciclo de vida do produto (PLC).** A maioria dos produtos passa por quatro estágios, e a estratégia de marketing correta muda em cada um:

segments.src: Introduction -> Growth -> Maturity -> Decline
segments.tr: Introduction -> Growth -> Maturity -> Decline

segments.src: - *Introduction:* low sales, high cost per customer, heavy spending to build awareness. Profits are often negative.
segments.tr: - *Introdução:* vendas baixas, alto custo por cliente, gastos pesados para construir consciência. Os lucros são frequentemente negativos.

segments.src: - *Growth:* sales accelerate, competitors arrive, you add features and channels.
segments.tr: - *Crescimento:* as vendas aceleram, chegam concorrentes, você adiciona recursos e canais.

segments.src: - *Maturity:* sales plateau, the fight turns to share and price, marketing shifts to differentiation and defending shelf space. Most products you know live here.
segments.tr: - *Maturidade:* as vendas se estabilizam, a luta se volta para participação e preço, o marketing muda para diferenciação e defesa do espaço nas prateleiras. A maioria dos produtos que você conhece vive aqui.

segments.src: - *Decline:* sales fall; you harvest (cut costs, milk cash flow) or divest.
segments.tr: - *Declínio:* as vendas caem; você colhe (reduz custos, maximiza fluxo de caixa) ou desinveste.

segments.src: Two honest caveats: the PLC is a description, not a law.
segments.tr: Dois pontos honestos: o PLC é uma descrição, não uma lei.

segments.src: Some products die in introduction; others (Coca-Cola, Tabasco, Levi's 501s) sit in maturity for a century.
segments.tr: Alguns produtos morrem na introdução; outros (Coca-Cola, Tabasco, Levi's 501s) ficam na maturidade por um século.

segments.src: And "decline" is sometimes a marketing failure, not a market verdict.
segments.tr: E "declínio" às vezes é uma falha de marketing, não um veredicto do mercado.

segments.src: Brand.** A brand is a name, term, sign, or design that identifies a seller's product and separates it from competitors.
segments.tr: Marca.** Uma marca é um nome, termo, sinal ou design que identifica o produto de um vendedor e o diferencia dos concorrentes.

segments.src: Its economic value — **brand equity** — is the extra response you get *because* of the name.
segments.tr: Seu valor econômico — **patrimônio da marca** — é a resposta extra que você obtém *por causa* do nome.

segments.src: Same laptop, two badges, different price people will pay: that gap is equity.
segments.tr: Mesmo laptop, dois badges, preço diferente que as pessoas pagarão: essa diferença é patrimônio.

segments.src: Equity comes from awareness (do they know you?), perceived quality, associations (what comes to mind?), and loyalty (will they walk past a cheaper option?).
segments.tr: O patrimônio vem da consciência (eles te conhecem?), qualidade percebida, associações (o que vem à mente?), e fidelidade (eles vão passar por uma opção mais barata?).

segments.src: Companies choose a **brand architecture**: a *house of brands* (P&G sells Tide, Charmin, Gillette — most shoppers don't connect them) or a *branded house* (Google Maps, Google Drive, Google Pay all borrow one reputation).
segments.tr: As empresas escolhem uma **arquitetura de marca**: uma *casa de marcas* (P&G vende Tide, Charmin, Gillette — a maioria dos compradores não as conecta) ou uma *casa de marca* (Google Maps, Google Drive, Google Pay compartilham uma reputação).

segments.tr: Casa de marcas circunscreve riscos; casa de marca dissemina boa vontade economicamente.

segments.src: Neither is free.
segments.tr: Nenhum dos dois é grátis.

segments.src: Packaging.** Packaging protects the product, communicates it, and increasingly *is* the experience — think of the box an iPhone comes in.
segments.tr: Embalagem.** A embalagem protege o produto, o comunica e cada vez mais *é* a experiência — pense na caixa em que um iPhone vem.

segments.src: On a crowded shelf, the package is often the only ad running at the moment of decision.

in.title: [Marketing 101 #7] Mengapa Produk Favorit Anda Benar-Benar Tiga Produk dalam Sebuah Mantel Tringgal

segments.src: > A "product" is not just the thing in the box — it's a bundle of benefits with a name, a look, and a lifespan, and marketers manage all four on purpose.
segments.tr: > Sebuah "produk" bukan hanya barang dalam kotak — itu adalah kumpulan manfaat dengan nama, penampilan, dan rentang hidup, dan pemasar mengelola keempat hal tersebut dengan sengaja.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Konsep Hari Ini

segments.src: Ask someone what Nike sells and they'll say sneakers.
segments.tr: Tanya seseorang apa yang dijual Nike dan mereka akan mengatakan sepatu kets.

segments.src: But you don't buy a sneaker — you buy cushioning on a long run, a look that works with jeans, and a swoosh that says something about you before you speak.
segments.tr: Tetapi Anda tidak membeli sepatu kets — Anda membeli bantalan untuk lari jarak jauh, penampilan yang cocok dengan jeans, dan swoosh yang mengatakan sesuatu tentang Anda sebelum Anda berbicara.

segments.src: Marketers formalize this with **three levels of product**:
segments.tr: Pemasar memformalkan ini dengan **tiga tingkat produk**:

segments.src: - **Core benefit** — the problem actually being solved (safe arrival, clean teeth, one less thing to worry about).
segments.tr: - **Manfaat inti** — masalah yang benar-benar diselesaikan (kedatangan yang aman, gigi bersih, satu hal yang tidak perlu dikhawatirkan).

segments.src: - **Actual product** — the tangible thing: features, quality level, design, brand name, packaging.
segments.tr: - **Produk aktual** — barang nyata: fitur, tingkat kualitas, desain, nama merek, kemasan.

segments.src: - **Augmented product** — everything wrapped around it: warranty, returns, delivery, customer support, the app, the community.
segments.tr: - **Produk yang ditingkatkan** — segalanya yang membungkusnya: garansi, pengembalian, pengiriman, dukungan pelanggan, aplikasi, komunitas.

segments.src: Competitors usually match you on the actual product fast.
segments.tr: Pesaing biasanya cocok dengan Anda di produk aktual dengan cepat.

segments.src: The core benefit is what you're really promising.
segments.tr: Manfaat inti adalah apa yang sebenarnya Anda janjikan.

segments.src: The augmented layer is where a lot of modern competition happens — free two-day shipping and a no-questions return policy are product decisions, not just logistics ones.
segments.tr: Lapisan yang ditingkatkan adalah tempat banyak persaingan modern terjadi — pengiriman gratis dua hari dan kebijakan pengembalian tanpa pertanyaan adalah keputusan produk, bukan hanya keputusan logistik.

segments.src: Four levers sit on top of that framework.
segments.tr: Empat tuas duduk di atas kerangka itu.

segments.src: The product life cycle (PLC).** Most products move through four stages, and the right marketing move changes in each one:
segments.tr: Siklus hidup produk (PLC).** Sebagian besar produk bergerak melalui empat tahap, dan langkah pemasaran yang tepat berubah di masing-masing:

segments.src: Introduction -> Growth -> Maturity -> Decline
segments.tr: Introduction -> Growth -> Maturity -> Decline

segments.src: - *Introduction:* low sales, high cost per customer, heavy spending to build awareness. Profits are often negative.
segments.tr: - *Pengenalan:* penjualan rendah, biaya tinggi per pelanggan, pengeluaran besar untuk membangun kesadaran. Keuntungan sering negatif.

segments.src: - *Growth:* sales accelerate, competitors arrive, you add features and channels.
segments.tr: - *Pertumbuhan:* penjualan meningkat, pesaing tiba, Anda menambahkan fitur dan saluran.

segments.src: - *Maturity:* sales plateau, the fight turns to share and price, marketing shifts to differentiation and defending shelf space. Most products you know live here.
segments.tr: - *Kematangan:* penjualan mencapai dataran, pertarungan beralih ke pangsa dan harga, pemasaran bergeser ke diferensiasi dan mempertahankan ruang rak. Sebagian besar produk yang Anda kenal tinggal di sini.

segments.src: - *Decline:* sales fall; you harvest (cut costs, milk cash flow) or divest.
segments.tr: - *Penurunan:* penjualan jatuh; Anda menuai (mengurangi biaya, mengumpulkan arus kas) atau melepaskan.

segments.src: Two honest caveats: the PLC is a description, not a law.
segments.tr: Dua peringatan jujur: PLC adalah deskripsi, bukan hukum.

segments.src: Some products die in introduction; others (Coca-Cola, Tabasco, Levi's 501s) sit in maturity for a century.
segments.tr: Beberapa produk mati di pengenalan; yang lain (Coca-Cola, Tabasco, Levi's 501s) tinggal di kematangan selama satu abad.

segments.src: And "decline" is sometimes a marketing failure, not a market verdict.
segments.tr: Dan "penurunan" kadang-kadang adalah kegagalan pemasaran, bukan keputusan pasar.

segments.src: Brand.** A brand is a name, term, sign, or design that identifies a seller's product and separates it from competitors.
segments.tr: Merek.** Merek adalah nama, istilah, tanda, atau desain yang mengidentifikasi produk penjual dan memisahkannya dari pesaing.

segments.src: Its economic value — **brand equity** — is the extra response you get *because* of the name.
segments.tr: Nilai ekonominya — **ekuitas merek** — adalah respons tambahan yang Anda dapatkan *karena* nama tersebut.

segments.src: Same laptop, two badges, different price people will pay: that gap is equity.
segments.tr: Laptop yang sama, dua lencana, harga berbeda yang akan dibayar orang: kesenjangan itu adalah ekuitas.

segments.src: Equity comes from awareness (do they know you?), perceived quality, associations (what comes to mind?), and loyalty (will they walk past a cheaper option?).
segments.tr: Ekuitas berasal dari kesadaran (apakah mereka tahu Anda?), kualitas yang dirasakan, asosiasi (apa yang terlintas di pikiran?), dan loyalitas (akankah mereka melewati opsi yang lebih murah?).

segments.src: Companies choose a **brand architecture**: a *house of brands* (P&G sells Tide, Charmin, Gillette — most shoppers don't connect them) or a *branded house* (Google Maps, Google Drive, Google Pay all borrow one reputation).
segments.tr: Perusahaan memilih **arsitektur merek**: *rumah merek* (P&G menjual Tide, Charmin, Gillette — sebagian besar pembeli tidak menghubungkan mereka) atau *rumah bermerek tunggal* (Google Maps, Google Drive, Google Pay semuanya meminjam satu reputasi).

segments.src: House of brands contains damage; branded house spreads goodwill cheaply.
segments.tr: Rumah merek berisi kerusakan; rumah bermerek tunggal menyebarkan niat baik dengan murah.

segments.src: Neither is free.
segments.tr: Tidak ada yang gratis.

segments.src: Packaging.** Packaging protects the product, communicates it, and increasingly *is* the experience — think of the box an iPhone comes in.
segments.tr: Kemasan.** Kemasan melindungi produk, mengomunikasikannya, dan semakin banyak *adalah* pengalaman — pikirkan kotak tempat iPhone datang.

segments.src: On a crowded shelf, the package is often the only ad running at the moment of decision.
segments.tr: Di rak yang ramai, paket sering kali menjadi satu-satunya iklan yang berjalan pada saat pengambilan keputusan.

segments.src: It also carries legal weight in the US: FDA-required Nutrition Facts, FTC rules against deceptive claims, and the growing scrutiny of "sustainable" labeling.
segments.tr: Ini juga memiliki bobot hukum di AS: Fakta Nutrisi yang diperlukan FDA, aturan FTC melawan klaim yang menipu, dan pengawasan yang berkembang terhadap pelabelan "berkelanjutan".

segments.src: New product development (NPD).** The standard funnel:
segments.tr: Pengembangan produk baru (NPD).** Corong standar:

segments.src: Idea generation -> Screening -> Concept test -> Business analysis
segments.tr: Idea generation -> Screening -> Concept test -> Business analysis

segments.src: -> Product development -> Test market -> Commercialization
segments.tr: -> Product development -> Test market -> Commercialization

segments.src: Each gate is designed to kill bad ideas cheaply.
segments.tr: Setiap gerbang dirancang untuk membunuh ide-ide buruk dengan murah.

segments.src: That's the point — failing at concept test costs a survey; failing at commercialization costs a factory run.
segments.tr: Itulah intinya — gagal pada uji konsep biaya survei; gagal pada komersial biaya lari pabrik.

segments.src: New consumer packaged goods fail at high rates (industry estimates commonly land somewhere in the 70–80% range, and definitions of "failure" vary a lot), which is exactly why the gates exist.
segments.tr: Barang kemasan konsumen baru gagal dengan tingkat tinggi (perkiraan industri biasanya berada di kisaran 70–80%, dan definisi "kegagalan" sangat bervariasi), yang persis mengapa gerbang ada.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari

segments.src: Walk down the beverage aisle at a Target in Ohio and watch all four levers at once.
segments.tr: Berjalan di depan rak minuman di Target di Ohio dan tonton keempat tuas sekaligus.

segments.src: **Coca-Cola Classic** is deep in maturity.
segments.tr: **Coca-Cola Klasik** jauh di dalam kematangan.

segments.src: The formula hasn't meaningfully changed, so the marketing is about occasions, packaging formats, and holding price — a 12-pack at roughly $8–9 is fighting on promotion and placement, not on innovation.
segments.tr: Formula tidak berubah secara bermakna, jadi pemasaran adalah tentang kesempatan, format kemasan, dan mempertahankan harga — paket 12-pack sekitar $8–9 berjuang dalam promosi dan penempatan, bukan inovasi.

segments.src: The brand equity is doing the heavy lifting: the red disc is recognizable at 20 feet.
segments.tr: Ekuitas merek melakukan angkat berat: piringan merah dapat dikenali dari jarak 20 kaki.

segments.src: Two shelves over, **Poppi** and **Olipop** are prebiotic sodas in growth stage.
segments.tr: Dua rak sebelumnya, **Poppi** dan **Olipop** adalah soda prebiotik dalam tahap pertumbuhan.

segments.src: Higher price (about $2.50–$3 a can), bright packaging built for Instagram, flavors launching and getting pulled fast.
segments.tr: Harga lebih tinggi (sekitar $2,50–$3 per kaleng), kemasan cerah yang dibangun untuk Instagram, rasa diluncurkan dan ditarik dengan cepat.

segments.src: That's textbook growth behavior: expand the line, grab distribution, don't worry yet about squeezing margin.
segments.tr: Itu adalah perilaku pertumbuhan buku teks: perluas lini, raih distribusi, jangan khawatir dulu tentang meremas margin.

segments.src: Note also what happened next — Olipop and Poppi grew fast enough that PepsiCo acquired Poppi in 2025 for roughly $1.65 billion.
segments.tr: Perhatikan juga apa yang terjadi berikutnya — Olipop dan Poppi tumbuh cukup cepat sehingga PepsiCo mengakuisisi Poppi pada 2025 dengan nilai sekitar $1,65 miliar.

segments.src: Buying a growth-stage brand is often cheaper than developing one, which is the quiet part of NPD strategy.
segments.tr: Membeli merek tahap pertumbuhan seringkali lebih murah daripada mengembangkannya, yang merupakan bagian diam dari strategi NPD.

segments.src: Now look at the branding architecture.
segments.tr: Sekarang lihat arsitektur merek.

segments.src: Coke uses a **branded house** for its trademark line — Coke Zero Sugar, Cherry Coke, Coca-Cola Spiced (launched 2024, discontinued within about a year).
segments.tr: Coke menggunakan **rumah bermerek tunggal** untuk lini merek dagang — Coke Zero Sugar, Cherry Coke, Coca-Cola Spiced (diluncurkan 2024, dihentikan dalam waktu sekitar setahun).

segments.src: That last one is a live PLC lesson: a product can be killed in introduction when trial doesn't convert to repeat.
segments.tr: Yang terakhir adalah pelajaran PLC langsung: produk dapat dibunuh dalam pengenalan ketika trial tidak berubah menjadi pengulangan.

segments.src: But Coca-Cola the *company* runs closer to a house of brands overall — Sprite, Dasani, Smartwater, Topo Chico and Fairlife don't lean on the Coke name at all, so a stumble in one doesn't drag the others.
segments.tr: Tetapi Coca-Cola *perusahaan* berjalan lebih dekat ke rumah merek secara keseluruhan — Sprite, Dasani, Smartwater, Topo Chico dan Fairlife tidak bergantung pada nama Coke sama sekali, jadi tersandung di salah satu tidak menyeret yang lain.

segments.src: And the packaging?
segments.tr: Dan kemasannya?

segments.src: The Poppi can's matte finish and oversized fruit graphic aren't decoration.
segments.tr: Kaleng Poppi dengan finishing matte dan grafis buah berukuran besar bukan dekorasi.

segments.src: They signal "not-a-soda soda" to someone scanning for three seconds — the augmented promise of gut health, delivered by aluminum.
segments.tr: Mereka menunjukkan "bukan-soda soda" kepada seseorang yang memindai selama tiga detik — janji yang ditingkatkan dari kesehatan usus, disampaikan oleh aluminium.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## Ringkasan Tiga Baris

segments.src: 1. A product operates on three levels — core benefit, actual product, augmented product — and competitors copy the middle one fastest.
segments.tr: 1. Produk beroperasi pada tiga tingkat — manfaat inti, produk aktual, produk yang ditingkatkan — dan pesaing menyalin yang di tengah paling cepat.

segments.src: 2. The product life cycle (introduction, growth, maturity, decline) changes which marketing moves make sense, but it describes a pattern rather than dictating a schedule.
segments.tr: 2. Siklus hidup produk (pengenalan, pertumbuhan, kematangan, penurunan) mengubah gerakan pemasaran mana yang masuk akal, tetapi menggambarkan pola daripada mendikte jadwal.

segments.src: 3. Brand equity, packaging, and a gated new-product development process are how firms build value that a feature list alone can't deliver.
segments.tr: 3. Ekuitas merek, kemasan, dan proses pengembangan produk baru yang gerbang adalah bagaimana perusahaan membangun nilai yang daftar fitur saja tidak dapat berikan.

ja.title: [マーケティング 101 #7] あなたの好きな製品は実は長いコートを着た3つの製品

segments.src: > A "product" is not just the thing in the box — it's a bundle of benefits with a name, a look, and a lifespan, and marketers manage all four on purpose.
segments.tr: > 「製品」とは箱の中の物単体ではなく、名前、外観、ライフスパンを持つ便益の束であり、マーケターはこれら4つを意図的に管理しています。

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 今日のコンセプト

segments.src: Ask someone what Nike sells and they'll say sneakers.
segments.tr: ナイキが何を売っているかと誰かに聞くと、スニーカーだと答えるでしょう。

segments.src: But you don't buy a sneaker — you buy cushioning on a long run, a look that works with jeans, and a swoosh that says something about you before you speak.
segments.tr: しかし、あなたはスニーカーを買うのではなく、長い走行での緩衝材、ジーンズに合う見た目、そしてあなたが話す前にあなたについて何かを言うスウッシュを買うのです。

segments.src: Marketers formalize this with **three levels of product**:
segments.tr: マーケターはこれを**製品の3つのレベル**で形式化します：

segments.src: - **Core benefit** — the problem actually being solved (safe arrival, clean teeth, one less thing to worry about).
segments.tr: - **コア・ベネフィット** — 実際に解決されている問題（安全な到着、きれいな歯、心配の1つ減）。

segments.src: - **Actual product** — the tangible thing: features, quality level, design, brand name, packaging.
segments.tr: - **実製品** — 有形のもの：機能、品質レベル、デザイン、ブランド名、パッケージング。

segments.src: - **Augmented product** — everything wrapped around it: warranty, returns, delivery, customer support, the app, the community.
segments.tr: - **拡張製品** — その周りのすべて：保証、返品、配送、カスタマーサポート、アプリ、コミュニティ。

segments.src: Competitors usually match you on the actual product fast.
segments.tr: 競合他社は通常、実製品ですぐにあなたに合わせます。

segments.src: The core benefit is what you're really promising.
segments.tr: コア・ベネフィットはあなたが本当に約束しているものです。

segments.src: The augmented layer is where a lot of modern competition happens — free two-day shipping and a no-questions return policy are product decisions, not just logistics ones.
segments.tr: 拡張レイヤーは多くの現代的な競争が起こる場所です — 無料の2日配送と質問なしの返品ポリシーは製品の決定であり、単なるロジスティクスの決定ではありません。

segments.src: Four levers sit on top of that framework.
segments.tr: 4つのレバーがそのフレームワークの上に位置します。

segments.src: The product life cycle (PLC).** Most products move through four stages, and the right marketing move changes in each one:
segments.tr: 製品ライフサイクル（PLC）。** ほとんどの製品は4つのステージを通過し、適切なマーケティング活動は各ステージで変わります：

segments.src: Introduction -> Growth -> Maturity -> Decline
segments.tr: Introduction -> Growth -> Maturity -> Decline

segments.src: - *Introduction:* low sales, high cost per customer, heavy spending to build awareness. Profits are often negative.
segments.tr: - *導入期：* 販売が低い、顧客あたりのコストが高い、認知度を構築するための大きな支出。利益はしばしば負です。

segments.src: - *Growth:* sales accelerate, competitors arrive, you add features and channels.
segments.tr: - *成長期：* 販売が加速し、競合他社が現れ、機能とチャネルを追加します。

segments.src: - *Maturity:* sales plateau, the fight turns to share and price, marketing shifts to differentiation and defending shelf space. Most products you know live here.
segments.tr: - *成熟期：* 販売が横ばい、争いがシェアと価格に移り、マーケティングが差別化と棚スペースの防衛にシフトします。あなたが知っているほとんどの製品はここに住んでいます。

segments.src: - *Decline:* sales fall; you harvest (cut costs, milk cash flow) or divest.
segments.tr: - *衰退期：* 販売が減少し、収穫（コスト削減、キャッシュフローの吸収）または売却します。

segments.src: Two honest caveats: the PLC is a description, not a law.
segments.tr: 2つの正直な警告：PLCは法則ではなく説明です。

segments.src: Some products die in introduction; others (Coca-Cola, Tabasco, Levi's 501s) sit in maturity for a century.
segments.tr: 一部の製品は導入期に死ぬ。その他（コカ・コーラ、タバスコ、リーバイス501）は1世紀成熟期に座ります。

segments.src: And "decline" is sometimes a marketing failure, not a market verdict.
segments.tr: そして「衰退」は時々マーケティング失敗であり、市場判決ではありません。

segments.src: Brand.** A brand is a name, term, sign, or design that identifies a seller's product and separates it from competitors.
segments.tr: ブランド。** ブランドは、売り手の製品を識別し、競合他社から分離する名前、用語、標識、またはデザインです。

segments.src: Its economic value — **brand equity** — is the extra response you get *because* of the name.
segments.tr: その経済的価値 — **ブランド・エクイティ** — は、名前*のために*得られる追加の応答です。

segments.src: Same laptop, two badges, different price people will pay: that gap is equity.
segments.tr: 同じラップトップ、2つのバッジ、異なる価格で人々が支払うでしょう：そのギャップはエクイティです。

segments.src: Equity comes from awareness (do they know you?), perceived quality, associations (what comes to mind?), and loyalty (will they walk past a cheaper option?).
segments.tr: エクイティは認知（あなたを知っていますか？）、認識された品質、関連性（何が思い浮かびますか？）、ロイヤルティ（より安い選択肢を通り過ぎますか？）から来ます。

segments.src: Companies choose a **brand architecture**: a *house of brands* (P&G sells Tide, Charmin, Gillette — most shoppers don't connect them) or a *branded house* (Google Maps, Google Drive, Google Pay all borrow one reputation).
segments.tr: 企業は**ブランド・アーキテクチャ**を選択します：*ブランドの家*（P&Gはタイド、チャーミン、ジレットを販売 — ほとんどのショッパーはそれらを接続しません）または*ブランド・ハウス*（GoogleマップスGoogleドライブ、Googleペイはすべて1つの評判を借ります）。

segments.src: House of brands contains damage; branded house spreads goodwill cheaply.
segments.tr: ブランドの家は損害を含みます。ブランド・ハウスは善意を安く広めます。

segments.src: Neither is free.
segments.tr: どちらも無料ではありません。

segments.src: Packaging.** Packaging protects the product, communicates it, and increasingly *is* the experience — think of the box an iPhone comes in.
segments.tr: パッケージング。** パッケージングは製品を保護し、それを伝え、ますます*経験である* — iPhoneが入ってくる箱を考えてください。

segments.src: On a crowded shelf, the package is often the only ad running at the moment of decision.
segments.tr: 混雑した棚の上で、パッケージはしばしば決定の瞬間に実行されている唯一の広告です。

segments.src: It also carries legal weight in the US: FDA-required Nutrition Facts, FTC rules against deceptive claims, and the growing scrutiny of "sustainable" labeling.
segments.tr: また、米国では法的な重みを持っています：FDA要件の栄養情報、虚偽の主張に対するFTC規則、および「持続可能な」ラベルの増加した精査。

segments.src: New product development (NPD).** The standard funnel:
segments.tr: 新製品開発（NPD）。** 標準的なファネル：

segments.src: Idea generation -> Screening -> Concept test -> Business analysis
segments.tr: Idea generation -> Screening -> Concept test -> Business analysis

segments.src: -> Product development -> Test market -> Commercialization
segments.tr: -> Product development -> Test market -> Commercialization

segments.src: Each gate is designed to kill bad ideas cheaply.
segments.tr: 各ゲートは悪い考えを安く殺すように設計されています。

segments.src: That's the point — failing at concept test costs a survey; failing at commercialization costs a factory run.
segments.tr: それが重要です — コンセプトテストで失敗するとサーベイコストがかかります。商用化で失敗するとファクトリーラン費用がかかります。

segments.src: New consumer packaged goods fail at high rates (industry estimates commonly land somewhere in the 70–80% range, and definitions of "failure" vary a lot), which is exactly why the gates exist.
segments.tr: 新しい消費者向けパッケージ商品は高い率で失敗し（業界の推定は一般的に70～80％の範囲に位置し、「失敗」の定義はかなり異なります）、これはゲートが存在する理由です。

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 日常生活で

segments.src: Walk down the beverage aisle at a Target in Ohio and watch all four levers at once.
segments.tr: オハイオ州のTargetの飲料通路を歩いて、4つのレバーすべてを一度に監視してください。

segments.src: **Coca-Cola Classic** is deep in maturity.
segments.tr: **コカ・コーラ・クラシック**は成熟期が深いです。

segments.src: The formula hasn't meaningfully changed, so the marketing is about occasions, packaging formats, and holding price — a 12-pack at roughly $8–9 is fighting on promotion and placement, not on innovation.
segments.tr: 処方は大きく変わっていないため、マーケティングは場面、パッケージング形式、および価格保有についてです — 約8～9ドルの12パックはプロモーションと配置で戦っており、イノベーションではありません。

segments.src: The brand equity is doing the heavy lifting: the red disc is recognizable at 20 feet.
segments.tr: ブランド・エクイティは大変な仕事をしています：赤いディスクは20フィートで認識可能です。

segments.src: Two shelves over, **Poppi** and **Olipop** are prebiotic sodas in growth stage.
segments.tr: 2つの棚を超えて、**Poppi**と**Olipop**は成長段階のプレバイオティックスソーダです。

segments.src: Higher price (about $2.50–$3 a can), bright packaging built for Instagram, flavors launching and getting pulled fast.
segments.tr: より高い価格（缶あたり約2.50～3ドル）、Instagram用に構築された明るいパッケージング、味が速く立ち上がり、引き出されています。

segments.src: That's textbook growth behavior: expand the line, grab distribution, don't worry yet about squeezing margin.
segments.tr: それは教科書的な成長行動です：行を展開し、分布をつかみ、まだマージンを絞ることを心配しないでください。

segments.src: Note also what happened next — Olipop and Poppi grew fast enough that PepsiCo acquired Poppi in 2025 for roughly $1.65 billion.
segments.tr: また、次に何が起こったかに注意してください — OlipopとPoppiは十分に速く成長しました。PepsiCoが2025年にPoppiを約16億5000万ドルで買収しました。

segments.src: Buying a growth-stage brand is often cheaper than developing one, which is the quiet part of NPD strategy.
segments.tr: 成長段階のブランドの購入は、1つを開発するより安いことが多いです。これはNPD戦略の静かな部分です。

segments.src: Now look at the branding architecture.
segments.tr: これでブランド・アーキテクチャを見てください。

segments.src: Coke uses a **branded house** for its trademark line — Coke Zero Sugar, Cherry Coke, Coca-Cola Spiced (launched 2024, discontinued within about a year).
segments.tr: コークは商標ラインに**ブランド・ハウス**を使用しています — コークゼロシュガー、チェリーコーク、コカ・コーラスパイス（2024年開始、約1年以内に廃止）。

segments.src: That last one is a live PLC lesson: a product can be killed in introduction when trial doesn't convert to repeat.
segments.tr: 最後のものはライブなPLCレッスンです：試行が繰り返しに変換されないとき、製品は導入時に殺すことができます。

segments.src: But Coca-Cola the *company* runs closer to a house of brands overall — Sprite, Dasani, Smartwater, Topo Chico and Fairlife don't lean on the Coke name at all, so a stumble in one doesn't drag the others.
segments.tr: しかし、コカ・コーラの*会社*は全体的にブランドの家に近く実行されています — スプライト、ダサニ、スマートウォーター、トポチコ、フェアライフはコークの名前にまったく頼らないため、1つの転倒が他の転倒を引きずりません。

segments.src: And the packaging?
segments.tr: そしてパッケージング？

segments.src: The Poppi can's matte finish and oversized fruit graphic aren't decoration.
segments.tr: Poppiは缶のマット仕上げと大きなフルーツグラフィックは装飾ではありません。

segments.src: They signal "not-a-soda soda" to someone scanning for three seconds — the augmented promise of gut health, delivered by aluminum.
segments.tr: 彼らは3秒間スキャンしている人に「ソーダではないソーダ」を信号します — アルミニウムによって提供される腸の健康の拡張された約束。

segments.src: ## Three-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## 3行要約

segments.src: 1. A product operates on three levels — core benefit, actual product, augmented product — and competitors copy the middle one fastest.
segments.tr: 1. 製品は3つのレベルで動作します — コア・ベネフィット、実製品、拡張製品 — そして競合他社は真ん中のものを最速でコピーします。

segments.src: 2. The product life cycle (introduction, growth, maturity, decline) changes which marketing moves make sense, but it describes a pattern rather than dictating a schedule.
segments.tr: 2. 製品ライフサイクル（導入、成長、成熟、衰退）は、どのマーケティング活動が意味があるかを変えますが、スケジュールを指示するのではなくパターンを説明します。

segments.src: 3. Brand equity, packaging, and a gated new-product development process are how firms build value that a feature list alone can't deliver.
segments.tr: 3. ブランド・エクイティ、パッケージング、およびゲートされた新製品開発プロセスは、企業がフィーチャーリストだけでは提供できない価値を構築する方法です。

segments.tr: ## ✅ 自己クイズ

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 今日の用語

segments.src: - **Core benefit** — the underlying problem the customer is actually paying to solve, beneath any feature.
segments.tr: - **コア・ベネフィット** — 顧客が実際に解決するために支払っている根本的な問題、あらゆる機能の下。

segments.src: - **Augmented product** — the support layer around the physical good: warranty, service, delivery, returns, community.
segments.tr: - **拡張製品** — 物理的な商品の周りのサポート層：保証、サービス、配送、返品、コミュニティ。

segments.src: - **Product life cycle (PLC)** — the introduction–growth–maturity–decline pattern many products follow, used to match strategy to stage.
segments.tr: - **製品ライフサイクル（PLC）** — 多くの製品が従う導入-成長-成熟-衰退パターン、戦略をステージに合わせるために使用。

segments.src: - **Brand equity** — the added value a brand name contributes to a product, visible as price premium, preference, or loyalty.
segments.tr: - **ブランド・エクイティ** — ブランド名が製品に貢献する追加価値、価格プレミアム、好み、またはロイヤルティとして表示。

segments.src: - **House of brands** — a portfolio strategy where individual brands stand alone, so reputation (and risk) doesn't transfer between them.
segments.tr: - **ブランドの家** — ポートフォリオ戦略で、個別のブランドが独立して立つため、評判（およびリスク）がそれらの間で転送されません。

segments.src: - **Test market** — a limited real-world launch used to check demand and marketing mix before full-scale rollout.
segments.tr: - **テストマーケット** — 限定的なリアルワールド立ち上げで、フルスケールロールアウト前に需要とマーケティングミックスを確認するために使用。

segments.src: *Answers: **Q1 — C.** Flat sales plus intense price competition is the signature of maturity; decline would show sales actually falling.
segments.tr: *回答：**Q1 — C。** フラット販売と激しい価格競争は成熟期の署名です。衰退は販売が実際に減少することを示すでしょう。

segments.src: **Q2 — X (false).** That's a house of brands: each brand stands alone.
segments.tr: **Q2 — X（偽）。** これはブランドの家です：各ブランドが独立して立ちます。

segments.src: A branded house is the opposite — one master name across products, like Google Maps and Google Drive.
segments.tr: ブランド・ハウスは反対です — GoogleマップスとGoogleドライブのような製品全体にわたる1つのマスター名。

segments.src: **Q3 — C.** Test market is the last gate before commercialization; it's the final cheap chance to find out you're wrong.*
segments.tr: **Q3 — C。** テストマーケットは商用化前の最後のゲートです。あなたが間違っていることを調べるための最終的な安い機会です。*

segments.tr: Zwei ehrliche Vorbehalte: Der PLC ist eine Beschreibung, kein Gesetz.

segments.src: Some products die in introduction; others (Coca-Cola, Tabasco, Levi's 501s) sit in maturity for a century.
segments.tr: Einige Produkte sterben bei der Einführung; andere (Coca-Cola, Tabasco, Levi's 501s) sitzen für ein Jahrhundert in der Reife.

segments.src: And "decline" is sometimes a marketing failure, not a market verdict.
segments.tr: Und "Rückgang" ist manchmal ein Marketingversagen, kein Markturteil.

segments.src: Brand.** A brand is a name, term, sign, or design that identifies a seller's product and separates it from competitors.
segments.tr: Marke.** Eine Marke ist ein Name, ein Begriff, ein Zeichen oder ein Design, das ein Produkt eines Verkäufers kennzeichnet und es von Konkurrenten unterscheidet.

segments.src: Its economic value — **brand equity** — is the extra response you get *because* of the name.
segments.tr: Sein wirtschaftlicher Wert — **Markenwert** — ist die zusätzliche Reaktion, die Sie *wegen* des Namens erhalten.

segments.src: Same laptop, two badges, different price people will pay: that gap is equity.
segments.tr: Gleicher Laptop, zwei Abzeichen, unterschiedlicher Preis, den Menschen zahlen: Diese Lücke ist der Markenwert.

segments.src: Equity comes from awareness (do they know you?), perceived quality, associations (what comes to mind?), and loyalty (will they walk past a cheaper option?).
segments.tr: Der Markenwert kommt aus dem Bewusstsein (kennen sie dich?), wahrgenommener Qualität, Assoziationen (was fällt dir ein?), und Loyalität (gehen sie an einer billigeren Option vorbei?).

segments.src: Companies choose a **brand architecture**: a *house of brands* (P&G sells Tide, Charmin, Gillette — most shoppers don't connect them) or a *branded house* (Google Maps, Google Drive, Google Pay all borrow one reputation).
segments.tr: Unternehmen wählen eine **Markenarchitektur**: ein *Markenportfolio* (P&G verkauft Tide, Charmin, Gillette — die meisten Käufer verbinden sie nicht) oder eine *Dachmarke* (Google Maps, Google Drive, Google Pay leihen sich alle einen Ruf).

segments.src: House of brands contains damage; branded house spreads goodwill cheaply.
segments.tr: Ein Markenportfolio begrenzt Schäden; eine Dachmarke verbreitet Goodwill billig.

segments.src: Neither is free.
segments.tr: Keiner ist kostenlos.

segments.src: Packaging.** Packaging protects the product, communicates it, and increasingly *is* the experience — think of the box an iPhone comes in.
segments.tr: Verpackung.** Die Verpackung schützt das Produkt, kommuniziert es und ist zunehmend *die* Erfahrung — denken Sie an die Box, in der ein iPhone kommt.

segments.src: On a crowded shelf, the package is often the only ad running at the moment of decision.
segments.tr: In einem überfüllten Regal ist die Verpackung oft die einzige Anzeige, die im Entscheidungsmoment läuft.

segments.src: It also carries legal weight in the US: FDA-required Nutrition Facts, FTC rules against deceptive claims, and the growing scrutiny of "sustainable" labeling.
segments.tr: Sie hat auch rechtliches Gewicht in den USA: FDA-erforderliche Nährwertangaben, FTC-Regeln gegen täuschende Ansprüche und die wachsende Überprüfung von "nachhaltiger" Kennzeichnung.

segments.src: New product development (NPD).** The standard funnel:
segments.tr: Neuentwicklung von Produkten (NPD).** Der Standard-Trichter:

segments.src: Idea generation -> Screening -> Concept test -> Business analysis
segments.tr: Idea generation -> Screening -> Concept test -> Business analysis

segments.src: -> Product development -> Test market -> Commercialization
segments.tr: -> Product development -> Test market -> Commercialization

segments.src: Each gate is designed to kill bad ideas cheaply.
segments.tr: Jedes Gate ist darauf ausgelegt, schlechte Ideen billig abzutöten.

segments.src: That's the point — failing at concept test costs a survey; failing at commercialization costs a factory run.
segments.tr: Das ist der Sinn — beim Konzepttest zu scheitern, kostet eine Umfrage; beim Vertrieb zu scheitern, kostet einen Fabrikanlauf.

segments.src: New consumer packaged goods fail at high rates (industry estimates commonly land somewhere in the 70–80% range, and definitions of "failure" vary a lot), which is exactly why the gates exist.
segments.tr: Neue Konsumprodukte schlagen fehl mit hohen Raten (Schätzungen der Branche landen normalerweise irgendwo im Bereich 70–80 %, und Definitionen von "Misserfolg" variieren stark), was genau der Grund ist, warum die Gates existieren.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Im Alltag

segments.src: Walk down the beverage aisle at a Target in Ohio and watch all four levers at once.
segments.tr: Gehen Sie den Getränkegang in einem Target in Ohio hinunter und beobachten Sie alle vier Hebel auf einmal.

segments.src: **Coca-Cola Classic** is deep in maturity.
segments.tr: **Coca-Cola Classic** ist tief in der Reife.

segments.src: The formula hasn't meaningfully changed, so the marketing is about occasions, packaging formats, and holding price — a 12-pack at roughly $8–9 is fighting on promotion and placement, not on innovation.
segments.tr: Die Formel hat sich nicht wesentlich geändert, daher geht es beim Marketing um Anlässe, Verpackungsformate und Preiserhaltung — ein 12er-Pack für etwa $8–9 kämpft auf Promotion und Platzierung, nicht auf Innovation.

segments.src: The brand equity is doing the heavy lifting: the red disc is recognizable at 20 feet.
segments.tr: Der Markenwert leistet die Schwerarbeit: die rote Scheibe ist aus 20 Fuß erkennbar.

segments.src: Two shelves over, **Poppi** and **Olipop** are prebiotic sodas in growth stage.
segments.tr: Zwei Regale weiter sind **Poppi** und **Olipop** prebiotische Limonaden in der Wachstumsphase.

segments.src: Higher price (about $2.50–$3 a can), bright packaging built for Instagram, flavors launching and getting pulled fast.
segments.tr: Höherer Preis (etwa $2,50–$3 pro Dose), helle Verpackung für Instagram, Geschmacksrichtungen, die schnell gestartet und schnell entfernt werden.

segments.src: That's textbook growth behavior: expand the line, grab distribution, don't worry yet about squeezing margin.
segments.tr: Das ist Lehrbuch-Wachstumsverhalten: Erweitern Sie die Linie, schnappen Sie sich die Verteilung, machen Sie sich noch keine Gedanken über das Ausquetschen der Marge.

segments.src: Note also what happened next — Olipop and Poppi grew fast enough that PepsiCo acquired Poppi in 2025 for roughly $1.65 billion.
segments.tr: Beachten Sie auch, was als nächstes passierte — Olipop und Poppi wuchsen schnell genug, dass PepsiCo Poppi 2025 für etwa $1,65 Milliarden akquirierte.

segments.src: Buying a growth-stage brand is often cheaper than developing one, which is the quiet part of NPD strategy.
segments.tr: Der Kauf einer Marke in der Wachstumsphase ist oft günstiger als die Entwicklung einer, was der stille Teil der NPD-Strategie ist.

segments.src: Now look at the branding architecture.
segments.tr: Schauen Sie sich jetzt die Markenarchitektur an.

segments.src: Coke uses a **branded house** for its trademark line — Coke Zero Sugar, Cherry Coke, Coca-Cola Spiced (launched 2024, discontinued within about a year).
segments.tr: Coke verwendet eine **Dachmarke** für seine Markenleitung — Coke Zero Sugar, Cherry Coke, Coca-Cola Spiced (gestartet 2024, nach etwa einem Jahr eingestellt).

segments.src: That last one is a live PLC lesson: a product can be killed in introduction when trial doesn't convert to repeat.
segments.tr: Das letztere ist eine Live-PLC-Lektion: Ein Produkt kann bei der Einführung getötet werden, wenn die Praxis nicht zum Wiederholen führt.

segments.src: But Coca-Cola the *company* runs closer to a house of brands overall — Sprite, Dasani, Smartwater, Topo Chico and Fairlife don't lean on the Coke name at all, so a stumble in one doesn't drag the others.
segments.tr: Aber Coca-Cola das *Unternehmen* läuft insgesamt näher an einem Markenportfolio — Sprite, Dasani, Smartwater, Topo Chico und Fairlife lehnen sich überhaupt nicht auf den Coke-Namen, daher zieht ein Stolper in einem die anderen nicht mit sich.

segments.src: And the packaging?
segments.tr: Und die Verpackung?

segments.src: The Poppi can's matte finish and oversized fruit graphic aren't decoration.
segments.tr: Die matte Oberfläche der Poppi-Dose und die übergroße Fruchtgrafik sind keine Dekoration.

segments.src: They signal "not-a-soda soda" to someone scanning for three seconds — the augmented promise of gut health, delivered by aluminum.
segments.tr: Sie signalisieren "nicht-eine-Limonade-Limonade" an jemanden, der für drei Sekunden scannt — das erweiterte Versprechen von Darmgesundheit, geliefert von Aluminium.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## Dreizeilige Zusammenfassung

segments.src: 1. A product operates on three levels — core benefit, actual product, augmented product — and competitors copy the middle one fastest.
segments.tr: 1. Ein Produkt operiert auf drei Ebenen — Kernvorteil, tatsächliches Produkt, erweitertes Produkt — und Konkurrenten kopieren das mittlere am schnellsten.

segments.src: 2. The product life cycle (introduction, growth, maturity, decline) changes which marketing moves make sense, but it describes a pattern rather than dictating a schedule.
segments.tr: 2. Der Produktlebenszyklus (Einführung, Wachstum, Reife, Rückgang) ändert, welche Marketingschritte Sinn machen, aber er beschreibt eher ein Muster als einen Zeitplan zu diktieren.

segments.src: 3. Brand equity, packaging, and a gated new-product development process are how firms build value that a feature list alone can't deliver.
segments.tr: 3. Markenwert, Verpackung und ein kontrollierter Neuentwicklungsprozess sind, wie Unternehmen Wert aufbauen, den eine Funktionsliste allein nicht liefern kann.
